4477-4875-7507-8043.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
4477-4875-7507-8043.description:
Cast Kindred Charge for free due to Vision, choosing a creature type granted by Conspiracy, creating a token copy of each creature you control with haste, and setting up a delayed exile trigger.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Greenwarden of Murasa token enters, it triggers, returning Kindred Charge from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

751-5223-6006.description:
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {U}.
When Shrieking Drake enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Shrieking Drake by tapping it, adding {U}.
Resolve the Shrieking Drake ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2324-5170-6132-8249.description:
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Proper Burial triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Defiant Salvager
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Proper Burial trigger.
Resolve the Proper Burial trigger, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Defiant Salvager
Repeat.

2835-6249-8095--5.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, it and Fecundity trigger.
Resolve the Fecundity trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the persist creature's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters the battlefield, Olivia triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature and causing you to discard a card.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

3560-6495-6888.description:
Cast Traveling Plague by paying {3}{B}{B}, attaching it to another creature you control.
When Traveling Plague enters, Archon of Sun's Grace triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing the creature Traveling Plague is attached to.
When the creature dies, Traveling Plague triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the token created in step 2.
When Traveling Plague enters, Archon of Sun's Grace triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat from step 3.
3560-6495-6888.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

4417-6034-8089.easyPrerequisites:
Pact Weapon attached to a creature you control.
Your life total is even.
4417-6034-8089.description:
Activate Hex Parasite by paying life.
Repeat step 1 until you have 0 life.
Cast Mister Negative by paying {5}{W}{B} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Mister Negative enters, it triggers, swapping your life total with an opponent's.
The opponent loses the game due to having 0 life.

3990-4067-7890.easyPrerequisites:
You control a land that can tap to produce {W}.
Incubation Druid has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
3990-4067-7890.description:
Activate Incubation Druid by tapping it, adding {W}{W}{W}.
Activate Gleaming Splendor by paying {2}{W}, causing you and an opponent to draw a card.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Incubation Druid.
Repeat.

789-1580-4871-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Gutter Grime trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

215-5434-5457.notablePrerequisites: You control at least seven creatures with different powers.
215-5434-5457.description:
Activate Selvala by tapping it, adding an amount of {G} or {W}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Selvala from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Selvala by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.
215-5434-5457.notes: Alternate the colors of mana you add each time. If you start adding {W}, you need {G} for Temur Sabertooth and {G} to cast Selvala

670-1619-6147-6473.notablePrerequisites: You are currently venturing in Tomb of Annihilation in the Trapped Entry room.
670-1619-6147-6473.description:
Cast Mardu Siegebreaker by paying its mana cost.
When Mardu Siegebreaker enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Mardu Siegebreaker trigger, exiling Rilsa Rael until Mardu Siegebreaker leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Mardu Siegebreaker.
Mardu Siegebreaker leaves the battlefield, causing Rilsa Rael to be returned to the battlefield from exile.
When Rilsa Rael enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Rilsa Rael trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Mardu Siegebreaker from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Mardu Siegebreaker enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Mardu Siegebreaker trigger, exiling Rilsa Rael until Mardu Siegebreaker leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 10, venturing into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 6, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Mardu Siegebreaker.
Repeat from step 5.

11-5938.manaNeeded: {1}{U}{U}{R}{R} plus enough mana to cast the additional instant or sorcery at most
11-5938.easyPrerequisites: You have an additional instant or sorcery card in hand with valid targets as applicable.
11-5938.description:
Cast any instant or sorcery by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Flare of Duplication by paying its mana cost, targeting the instant or sorcery cast in step 1.
Cast Narset's Reversal by paying {U}{U}, copying Flare of Duplication targeting the spell cast in step 1 and returning the original Flare of Duplication to your hand.
Cast Flare of Duplication by paying its mana cost, copying the copy of Flare of Duplication, targeting the copy of Flare of Duplication.
Resolve the copy of Flare of Duplication, creating a copy of Flare of Duplication targeting the copy of Flare of Duplication.
Repeat step 5.
11-5938.notes: You can sacrifice a creature to cast Flare of Duplication instead if desired.

2104-2556-5144.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Ephemerate by paying {W}, blinking Mnemonic Wall and exiling Ephemerate.
When Mnemonic Wall enters, it triggers, returning Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your upkeep, Ephemerate's rebound ability triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Ephemerate, blinking Mnemonic Wall.
When Mnemonic Wall enters, it triggers, returning Ephemerate from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

280-423-1257-1437--85.easyPrerequisites: Myojin of Cryptic Dreams has at least two indestructible counters on it.
280-423-1257-1437--85.description:
Cast Walking Atlas by paying {2}.
Holding priority, activate Myojin of Cryptic Dreams by removing an indestructible counter from it, copying the Walking Atlas spell three times.
Resolve the first Walking Atlas copy.
Activate the Walking Atlas token by tapping it,, putting Golgari Rot Farm from your hand onto the battlefield.
Golgari Rot Farm enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Evolution Sage.
Resolve the Golgari Rot Farm trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Evolution Sage trigger, putting an indestructible counter on Myojin of Cryptic Dreams.
Repeat from step 3 two additional times.
Repeat from step 2.

339-677-2292-7296.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1563-1849-3490-7075.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that has not been tapped this turn.
1563-1849-3490-7075.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, adding {1}.
The creature's ability granted to it by Tale of Katara and Toph triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

1846-4222-7014.easyPrerequisites:
You control an Island.
Freed from the Real attached to North Pole Patrol.
North Pole Patrol does not have summoning sickness.
1846-4222-7014.description:
Cast High Tide by paying {U}.
Activate an Island by tapping it, adding {U}.
High Tide triggers, adding {U}.
Activate North Pole Patrol by tapping it, untapping the Island.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping North Pole Patrol.
Repeat from step 2

856-2232-4050-6976.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Cauldron Familiar enters, it and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning City Pigeon from the battlefield to your hand.
City Pigeon triggers, creating a Food token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar, adding {W}.
Cast City Pigeon by paying {W}.
When City Pigeon enters, Cloudstone Curio triggers. Choose not to return anything to your hand.
Repeat.

1734-3817-4050.description:
Cast Fiend Hunter by paying its mana cost.
When Fiend Hunter enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Sister Hospitaller.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Fiend Hunter.
When Fiend Hunter dies, its second ability triggers, returning Sister Hospitaller from exile to the battlefield.
When Sister Hospitaller enters, it triggers, returning Fiend Hunter from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Fiend Hunter enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Sister Hospitaller.
Repeat from step 3.

907-1399-1606-1680.description:
Activate Selesnya Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {G}{W}
Activate Ley Weaver by tapping it, untapping Wirewood Lodge and Selesnya Sanctuary.
Activate Wirewood Lodge's second ability by paying {G} and tapping it, untapping Ley Weaver.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

1878-2713-3454-4539-5498.easyPrerequisites: An opponent has six or more cards in hand.
1878-2713-3454-4539-5498.description:
Activate Sunforger by paying {R}{W} and unattaching it, searching your library for Jeska's Will and casting it without paying its mana cost, adding at least six {R}.
Activate Sunforger's equip ability by paying {1}, attaching it to Zirda.
Activate Sunforger by paying {R}{W} and unattaching it, searching your library for Unexpected Windfall and casting it without paying its mana cost and discarding a card.
Resolve Unexpected Windfall, causing you to draw two cards and create two Treasures.
Activate Sunforger's equip ability by paying {1}, attaching it to Zirda.
Activate Reito Lantern twice by paying {2}, putting Unexpected Windfall and Jeska's Will from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {W}{W}.
Repeat.

2933-4499-4927-5798.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Drowner of Hope.
When Drowner of Hope enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating two 1/1 Eldrazi Scion creature tokens.
Activate the Eldrazi Scions by tapping them, adding {2}.
Activate an Eldrazi Scion by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite tapped Eldrazi Scion tokens, you may sacrifice them for infinite {C}, and then forego tapping or sacrificing subsequent Eldrazi Scions.

1379-4853-4917-6429.notablePrerequisites: An opponent controls four or more nonbasic lands.
1379-4853-4917-6429.description:
Activate Jan Jansen's first ability by tapping it and sacrificing Razorlash Transmogrant.
When Razorlash Transmogrant dies, Dross Scorpion triggers, untapping Jan Jansen.
Resolve the Jan Jansen ability, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Activate Razorlash Transmogrant by paying {B}{B}, putting it from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
Repeat.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

2511-5434-5555-6331.easyPrerequisites: Stiltzkin, Moogle Merchant does not have summoning sickness.
2511-5434-5555-6331.notablePrerequisites: You control a face-down creature whose front face is a permanent card.
2511-5434-5555-6331.description:
Activate Stiltzkin by paying {2} and tapping it, giving control of Karlov Watchdog to an opponent.
During the opponent's turn, activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing a face-down creature you control.
When the creature dies, Yarus's second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a 2/2 creature, and then not turning it face-up due to Karlov Watchdog.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat from step 2.

5445-5641.easyPrerequisites: Tarrian's Soulcleaver attached to Basking Broodscale.
5445-5641.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
5445-5641.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
When the Eldrazi Spawn dies, Tarrian's Soulcleaver triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Repeat from step 2.

681-1644-4423-4826-5142.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one Forest and two additional lands.
Archelos is untapped.
681-1644-4423-4826-5142.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary, a Forest and two other lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{G}.
Activate Spitting Spider four times by sacrificing Mystic Sanctuary, a Forest and two other lands, dealing 4 damage to each creature with flying.
Cast Splendid Reclamation by paying {3}{G}, returning all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Archelos.
When each land enters the battlefield, Tatyova triggers that many times, and Mystic Sanctuary triggers once.
Resolve the Mystic Sanctuary trigger, putting Splendid Reclamation on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Tatyova triggers, causing you to draw that many cards and gain that much life.
Repeat.
If you control additional lands, you may sacrifice them as well to get additional mana and triggers.

567-2034-2161-3490.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
567-2034-2161-3490.description:
Cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
Soul's Attendant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Scion of the Swarm triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Soul's Attendant triggers.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Soul's Attendant trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 3.

1778-2218-4763-5147.description:
Cast Memnite by paying {0}.
When Memnite enters the battlefield, Ronin Warclub triggers, attaching Ronin Warclub to Memnite.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Memnite.
When Memnite dies, Koll triggers, returning Memnite from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

2034-2645-4871-4917.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional noncreature artifact.
2034-2645-4871-4917.description:
Activate Jan Jansen's second ability by tapping it and sacrificing any other noncreature artifact, creating two 1/1 Construct creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing both Construct tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
When the Constructs die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3}, untapping Jan Jansen.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

1706-2438-4191-5220.description:
Cast Cloudkin Seer by paying {0}.
Cloudkin Seer enters the battlefield, triggering its ability.
Holding priority, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Cloudkin Seer.
Cloudkin Seer dies, triggering Mortuary, putting Cloudkin Seer on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Cloudkin Seer trigger from step 2, causing you to draw Cloudkin Seer from the top of your library.
Repeat.
